findings.message: Claims 50 t of recycled polyester yarn, but the certified recycled inputs (30 t) can give at most 29.1 t, even at the best realistic yield. About 20.9 t would have to be virgin material labelled as recycled.
Recycled share of 100.0% is far above this plant's usual 56.5% (robust z = 19.6). Ask what changed in its supply.
